titulo: CVS Health and International Paper: a quarter's net income next to a closing plan
caption:
CVS Health and International Paper: a quarter's net income next to a closing plan

From the archive: 2021 to 2023.

CVS Health, Nov 17, 2021
The math: $1.598 billion (net income attributable to CVS Health, Q3 2021) ÷ about 900 (stores in the plan the board authorized, 8-K Nov 2021) = about $1.77 million of Q3 2021 net income per store in the Nov 2021 plan

International Paper, Oct 17, 2023
The math: $165 million (net earnings, Q3 2023) ÷ about 565 (employees the Orange mill closure is expected to reduce, 8-K Oct 2023) = about $292,035 of Q3 2023 net earnings per employee in the Oct 2023 plan

Strong. As expected. Here is the quarter column. (Our take.)

Sources: CVS Health, Form 8-K, filed Nov 3, 2021; CVS Health, Form 8-K, filed Nov 18, 2021; International Paper, Form 8-K, filed Oct 26, 2023; International Paper, Form 8-K, filed Oct 18, 2023.

Slide 5 of 6. Cobalt blue poster with white type. Title: What this does not say. The two numbers are from different dates. We say which quarter and which 8-K for each. CVS Health's board authorized a plan to close approximately 900 stores over three years. The 8-K says it may change. No store is counted as closed. International Paper's 565 is the Orange mill only. The 8-K also names other jobs, which we do not count. A job in a plan is not a named person. Our take: Strong. As expected. Here is the quarter column.
